teacher.challenge: Stand up for something 'good' today, even if it makes you feel slightly awkward. Courage is a muscle; flex it.

teacher.title: Preparation for the Harvest
teacher.message: The field is white already to harvest. You are 75% of the way through this 120-day training. You are becoming a master-harvester.
teacher.challenge: Look back at your goals from Day 1. What is the one thing you are most proud of changing in your life so far?

teacher.title: Month 3 Mastery Reflection
teacher.message: Reflection: You have finished Month 3. How has your 'Watchman's Vision' improved? Do you see the needs of others more clearly?
teacher.challenge: Share one specific experience where you 'strengthened the brethren' this month with your Quorum President.

priest.title: The Authority to Baptize
priest.message: The Priest's duty is to 'baptize.' This is the first saving ordinance. Your authority is the bridge between a soul and the kingdom of God.
priest.challenge: Find your own baptismal date (ask a parent or check Member Tools). Spend a moment reflecting on how your life changed after that day.

priest.title: Administering the Sacrament
priest.message: A Priest 'administers' the sacrament. To administer means to manage or give. You are giving the Atonement of Jesus Christ to the congregation through the bread and water.
priest.challenge: Read the sacrament prayers (D&C 20:77, 79). Identify the one word in each prayer that stands out to you most today.

priest.title: The Power of the Prayer
priest.message: The Elders and Priests 'knelt down with the church.' The posture of a Priest is one of humility. Power comes from the kneeling, not just the speaking.
priest.challenge: Kneel for your morning and evening prayers today. Focus on the feeling of 'submitting' your will to the Father's.

priest.title: Watching for the Stray
priest.message: A Priest is a shepherd in training. He notices who is 'missing from the table.' The rescue begins with a simple observation.
priest.challenge: Who was missing from your quorum or class last Sunday? Send them a short text saying, 'Missed you on Sunday! Hope you're doing well.'

priest.title: The Key of the Ministering of Angels
priest.message: Priests hold the keys of the ministering of angels. This means you have a right to receive help from beyond the veil to know how to rescue your friends.
priest.challenge: Pray specifically for a friend who is struggling with a trial. Ask for an 'angel' (mortal or immortal) to visit them today.

priest.title: The Power of Exhortation
priest.message: A Priest is to 'exhort.' To exhort means to strongly encourage or urge someone to do something good. Your voice has the power to spark action in others.
priest.challenge: Identify a good habit you know a friend is trying to start. Give them a 'spiritual exhortation' (encouragement) to keep going.

priest.title: Pure Knowledge
priest.message: Priesthood influence is maintained by 'pure knowledge.' As a Priest, you must know the doctrine to teach it effectively. Studying is part of your training.
priest.challenge: Read one chapter of the Book of Mormon today with the goal of finding one 'pure truth' you can share with someone else.

priest.title: The Order of the Table
priest.message: The Lord provides a specific pattern for the sacrament. This 'order' brings peace and focus. How you prepare yourself reflects your respect for the Master.
priest.challenge: Prepare your Sunday clothes and any materials you need for your calling today, rather than waiting for Sunday morning.

priest.title: Leading the Meeting
priest.message: Priests are to 'conduct the meetings as they are led by the Holy Ghost.' This requires being 'in tune' before the meeting even starts.
priest.challenge: Next time you are in a meeting, pay attention to the 'feeling' of the room. Pray silently that the Spirit will guide whoever is leading.

priest.title: The Sabbath Shield
priest.message: The Sabbath is a sign between you and God. As a Priest, you help set the standard for how the world views the Lord's day.
priest.challenge: Make a 'Sabbath Plan.' Decide now on one activity you will avoid and one spiritual activity you will add to make Sunday holy.

priest.title: Sunday Reflection: The Ordinance
priest.message: Reflection: 'In the ordinances thereof, the power of godliness is manifest.' Did you feel that power today at the sacrament table?
priest.challenge: Write your reflection in your journal.

priest.title: The Power of the Bishop's Quorum
priest.message: The Bishop is the President of the Priest's Quorum. He holds the keys for your quorum. Standing with him gives you access to those keys.
priest.challenge: Ask the Bishop or one of his counselors: 'Is there anything I can do this week to help you or the ward?'

priest.title: The Spirit of Prophecy
priest.message: The testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy. When a Priest shares his testimony, he is using a prophetic gift to change the future of the listener.
priest.challenge: Write down three things you KNOW about Jesus Christ. This is the foundation of your 'Priest's Testimony.'

priest.title: The Power of Forgiveness
priest.message: A Priest who administers the sacrament must be a Priest who understands forgiveness. If you carry a grudge, you block the power of the ordinance.
priest.challenge: Is there anyone you haven't fully forgiven? Say a prayer specifically for their well-being today.

priest.title: The Priest's Guard
priest.message: The Priests and the Teachers were 'watchmen' on the towers. As a Priest, you are a guard for the sanctity of your home and your quorum.
priest.challenge: Identify one 'weak spot' in your daily routine where temptation often enters. Set a 'guard' (a new rule or habit) at that spot today.

priest.title: Walking in the Spirit
priest.message: If you walk in the Spirit, you will not fulfill the lust of the flesh. A Priest's power is tied to his purity. The more you 'walk' with God, the more He works through you.
priest.challenge: Spend 10 minutes walking outside today without any music or phone. Use the time to talk to the Lord in your heart.

priest.title: The Power of the Invite
priest.message: A Priest invites all to come. Your invitation is more than a social ask; it is a Priesthood calling. When you invite, you are acting on the Lord's behalf.
priest.challenge: Invite a friend to attend a youth activity or Sunday meeting with you. Don't worry about the answer; just make the invite.

priest.title: Sunday Reflection: The Rescue
priest.message: Reflection: 'He which converteth the sinner... shall save a soul from death.' Who did you try to 'rescue' or invite this week?
priest.challenge: Write your reflection in your journal.

priest.title: Preparing for the Melchizedek Priesthood
priest.message: The Priest's office is the final step before the Melchizedek Priesthood. You are training for the 'Higher Priesthood' by being faithful in the 'Lesser.'
priest.challenge: Ask a Melchizedek Priesthood holder (your Dad, an Uncle, or a leader): 'What is the most important lesson you learned as a Priest?'

priest.title: The Power of Sanctification
priest.message: Sanctify yourselves... that your minds become single to God. A Priest with a 'single eye' to God's glory has a power that others cannot explain.
priest.challenge: Pick one 'worldly' distraction (social media, a game, or a specific app) and fast from it for 24 hours to focus your mind.

priest.title: Becoming a King and Priest
priest.message: The Lord's goal is to make you a 'King and Priest.' This starts with how you treat yourself. You are royalty in training.
priest.challenge: Clean your room or workspace with the care you would use if you were preparing it for a King. Dignity starts in the details.

priest.title: The Shield of Faith
priest.message: A Priest must stand in the 'front lines.' Your faith is the shield that protects those behind you—your younger siblings, your quorum, and your friends.
priest.challenge: Identify a standard you are tempted to 'lower.' Re-commit to it today. Your strength will strengthen someone else.

priest.title: The Power of the Word
priest.message: The word of God is quick and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword. A Priest's best weapon is his knowledge of the scriptures.
priest.challenge: Find a scripture that answers a question you've had lately. Share that verse with a parent or friend today.

priest.title: The Oath and Covenant
priest.message: You are approaching the end of Month 3. You are proving yourself worthy of the 'Oath and Covenant.' The Father is watching your faithfulness in the small things.
priest.challenge: Read D&C 84:38. Write down what you think 'all that my Father hath' actually includes.

priest.title: Sunday Reflection: The Keys
priest.message: Reflection: How have you seen the 'Ministering of Angels' or the 'Key of Repentance' work in your life this month?
priest.challenge: Write your reflection in your journal.

priest.title: The Priesthood of Aaron
priest.message: Aaron was called of God by Moses. You were called of God by your Bishop. You are part of a literal, physical lineage of authority.
priest.challenge: Look at your Priesthood Line of Authority if you have it. If not, ask your ward clerk for a copy. Study the names of the men who came before you.

priest.title: The Power of Charity
priest.message: Without charity, a Priest is just 'sounding brass.' The ordinances you perform only have power if they are done with love for the people you are serving.
priest.challenge: Do one act of service today for someone who cannot possibly repay you. Keep it a secret.

priest.title: The Priest's Courage
priest.message: Be strong and of a good courage. A Priest often has to lead when others are afraid to. Your courage gives others permission to be brave.
priest.challenge: Speak up for the truth in a situation today where it might be easier to stay silent. You don't have to be loud, just firm.

priest.title: Preparing for the Finish
priest.message: Wherefore, now let every man learn his duty. You have nearly completed 90 days of training. You are becoming a master of your duty.
priest.challenge: List three 'duties' of a Priest that you feel much more confident in now than you did on Day 1.

priest.title: Month 3 Mastery Reflection
priest.message: Reflection: You have finished Month 3. How has your 'Priest's Voice' grown? Do you feel the authority of your office when you speak or pray?
priest.challenge: Share one experience from this month with your Bishop during your next interview.

elder.title: The Duty to Confirm
elder.message: The Elder's duty is to 'confirm those who are baptized into the church, by the laying on of hands for the baptism of fire.' You are the one who helps bestow the Gift of the Holy Ghost.
elder.challenge: Reflect on your own confirmation. Write down one way the 'Gift' of the Holy Ghost has actually changed your decision-making this week.

elder.title: Watching Over the Church
elder.message: An Elder is to 'watch over the church always, and be with and strengthen them.' This is the scriptural foundation of Ministering.
elder.challenge: Call or text the individuals you minister to. Instead of asking 'if they need anything,' share a specific thought from your scripture study today.

elder.title: The Power of Blessing
elder.message: The Elders of the church shall be called to lay hands on the sick. You are a conduit for the Lord's healing power.
elder.challenge: Review the 'Instructions for Priesthood Ordinances and Blessings' in the General Handbook (Section 18). Ensure you are ready to perform a blessing at a moment's notice.

elder.title: Standing in the Gap
elder.message: The Lord seeks for a man who will 'make up the hedge, and stand in the gap.' As an Elder, you stand between the world's influence and the peace of the Saints.
elder.challenge: Identify a 'gap' in your family or ward (someone who is lonely, a task undone) and stand in it today.

elder.title: The Key of Spiritual Blessings
elder.message: The Melchizedek Priesthood holds the keys of 'all the spiritual blessings of the church.' You have the right to claim these blessings for your family.
elder.challenge: Pray specifically for a spiritual gift today—such as discernment or tongues (to know what to say)—that will help you serve better.

elder.title: Administering in Spiritual Things
elder.message: Your office is to 'administer in spiritual things.' This means you focus on the heart and the soul, not just the physical organization.
elder.challenge: In your next conversation with a friend, steer the topic toward something of spiritual substance rather than just entertainment or news.

elder.title: The Spirit of the Quorum
elder.message: The Elder's Quorum is a place of brotherhood and council. You are responsible for the 'warmth' of your quorum.
elder.challenge: Sit by someone you don't know well in your next quorum meeting. Learn one thing about their life outside of church.

elder.title: Sunday Reflection: The Shepherd
elder.message: Reflection: 'The good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.' How did you 'give your life' (your time and ego) to someone else this week?
elder.challenge: Write your reflection in your journal.

elder.title: The Power of Persuasion
elder.message: No power can be maintained by virtue of the priesthood, only by persuasion and long-suffering. Elders lead by invitation, never by force.
elder.challenge: The next time you want someone to do something, try to 'persuade' them by explaining the 'why' and showing love, rather than just asking for the 'what.'

elder.title: Leading in the Home
elder.message: Reproving betimes with sharpness, when moved upon by the Holy Ghost; and then showing forth an increase of love. This is the pattern for a Priesthood father or brother.
elder.challenge: If you have to correct someone today, ensure the 'increase of love' afterward is twice as strong as the correction.

elder.title: The Melchizedek Legacy
elder.message: Melchizedek was a king of peace. As an Elder, you are a 'Prince of Peace' in your home. Your presence should lower the stress level of the room.
elder.challenge: Consciously try to be the 'calm' in a stressful situation at home or work today.

elder.title: Washing the Feet
elder.message: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
elder.challenge: Do a 'lowly' service today—something that feels 'beneath' you. This is the true spirit of an Elder.

elder.title: The Power of the Word
elder.message: The preaching of the word had a 'more powerful effect' than the sword. Your ability to teach the gospel is your most effective tool as a Shepherd.
elder.challenge: Prepare a 1-minute 'spiritual thought' that you could share if asked suddenly.

elder.title: Succoring the Weak
elder.message: Succor the weak, lift up the hands which hang down, and strengthen the feeble knees. An Elder looks for the person who is about to give up.
elder.challenge: Is there someone in your ward who hasn't been there for a few weeks? Reach out with a 'no-pressure' message of support.

elder.title: Sunday Reflection: The Spirit
elder.message: Reflection: 'For the word of the Lord is truth, and whatsoever is truth is light.' Where did you see 'Light' in your ministering this week?
elder.challenge: Write your reflection in your journal.

elder.title: A Life of Consecration
elder.message: Consecration isn't just about money; it's about your time. An Elder consecrates his talents to build the kingdom.
elder.challenge: Offer one specific talent you have (tech help, fixing things, organizing) to your Quorum President for those in need.

elder.title: The Law of the Gospel
elder.message: The Elders and Priests shall teach the principles of my gospel, which are in the Bible and the Book of Mormon.
elder.challenge: Study one chapter of 'Preach My Gospel' today. You are a lifelong missionary.

elder.title: Holding the Keys of the Ministry
elder.message: Peter, James, and John committed the keys of your ministry. You are part of the literal 'Apostolic' authority on earth.
elder.challenge: Look up the names of the current Quorum of the Twelve. Pray for one of them by name today.

elder.title: The High Calling of Fatherhood
elder.message: Whether you are a father now or will be in the future, your Priesthood is the foundation of your family's spiritual safety.
elder.challenge: Write down 3 qualities you want your (current or future) children to see in your Priesthood service.

elder.title: The Power of Example
elder.message: Be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
elder.challenge: Pick one of those six areas from the scripture to 'over-perform' in today.

elder.title: Enduring to the End
elder.message: Ye must press forward with a steadfastness in Christ. An Elder is a 'steady hand' on the wheel.
elder.challenge: What is one spiritual habit that has started to 'slip' lately? Re-establish it today.

elder.title: Sunday Reflection: The Covenant
elder.message: Reflection: 'He that receiveth me receiveth my Father.' How did you 'receive' the Lord through your service this Sunday?
elder.challenge: Write your reflection in your journal.

elder.title: The Stewardship of the Earth
elder.message: The Lord has given us the earth for our use. An Elder respects God's creations as part of his Priesthood stewardship.
elder.challenge: Spend 15 minutes in nature today. Express gratitude to God for the specific beauty of the world around you.

elder.title: The Power of Testimony
elder.message: Ye are blessed, for the testimony which ye have borne is recorded in heaven for the angels to look upon.
elder.challenge: Share your testimony with one person today—even if it's just a 30-second 'I know this is true' in a text.

elder.title: The Call to Serve
elder.message: If ye have desires to serve God ye are called to the work. Desire is the first qualification.
elder.challenge: Check your 'desire' levels. If they are low, ask the Lord today to 'renew a right spirit' within you.

elder.title: The Fellowship of the Saints
elder.message: The church did meet together oft, to fast and to pray, and to speak one with another concerning the welfare of their souls.
elder.challenge: Plan a 'welfare check' (a casual visit or call) with a brother in your quorum this week.

elder.title: The Shield of the Quorum
elder.message: Every decision made by these quorums must be by the unanimous voice of the same. Unity is our protection.
elder.challenge: If there is any contention between you and a quorum member, resolve it today.

elder.title: The Final Push
elder.message: Wherefore, now let every man learn his duty. You are entering the final stage of your 90-day mastery.
elder.challenge: Review your goals from Day 1. How many have you reached?

elder.title: Preparing for the Harvest
elder.message: The field is white already to harvest. An Elder is a laborer in that harvest.
elder.challenge: Identify one 'fruit' (a person or a project) that is ready for harvest in your life. Focus your energy there today.

elder.title: Month 3 Mastery Reflection
elder.message: Reflection: How has your 'Elder's Voice' (a voice of authority and comfort) developed this month?
elder.challenge: Record your thoughts in your journal.

high_Priest.title: The Power of Godliness
high_Priest.message: In the ordinances of the Melchizedek priesthood, the power of godliness is manifest. You are a guardian of this power.
high_Priest.challenge: Meditate on the phrase 'power of godliness.' What does it look like in your daily life?

high_Priest.title: The Great High Priest
high_Priest.message: Jesus Christ is the Great High Priest. Our service is merely an extension of His perfect intercession.
high_Priest.challenge: Identify one way you can better represent Christ's mercy when you preside or lead today.

high_Priest.title: The Heart of the Ordinance
high_Priest.message: Ordinances are not rituals; they are conduits for grace. High Priests ensure they are performed with dignity and spirit.
high_Priest.challenge: Review the instructions for an ordinance you haven't performed in a while to ensure technical and spiritual readiness.

high_Priest.title: Standing as a Witness
high_Priest.message: Priesthood service is about being a witness of God at all times and in all places.
high_Priest.challenge: Share a spiritual truth with someone today outside of a church setting.

high_Priest.title: The Spirit of Discernment
high_Priest.message: High Priests are often called to judge or preside. The gift of discernment is essential to see people as God sees them.
high_Priest.challenge: Pray specifically for the gift of discernment before your next interaction with someone you find difficult.

high_Priest.title: Melchizedek’s Legacy
high_Priest.message: Melchizedek was a king of peace. High Priests should be the foremost peacemakers in the ward and stake.
high_Priest.challenge: Identify a 'storm' in your family or quorum and intentionally bring a 'calm' influence to it today.

high_Priest.title: The Weight of the Keys
high_Priest.message: High Priests have a right to officiate in all offices. This requires a broad understanding of the entire work of salvation.
high_Priest.challenge: Read about the duties of a Deacon. How can you better support the youth in their specific responsibilities?

high_Priest.title: Presiding with Love
high_Priest.message: No power or influence can or ought to be maintained by virtue of the priesthood, only by persuasion and long-suffering.
high_Priest.challenge: Replace a command with an invitation in your leadership or parenting today.

high_Priest.title: The Sentinel's Watch
high_Priest.message: High Priests act as watchmen. You must be spiritually awake to warn and protect those under your care.
high_Priest.challenge: Take 10 minutes to scan your 'horizon'—who in your circle is drifting, and how can you reach out?

high_Priest.title: The Higher Law
high_Priest.message: The Melchizedek Priesthood invites us to live a higher law of consecration and holiness.
high_Priest.challenge: Give up one comfort today and donate the time or resources saved to someone in need.

high_Priest.title: Spiritual Stewardship
high_Priest.message: Every High Priest is a steward. We will all give an account of the souls we were asked to watch over.
high_Priest.challenge: Write down the names of those you are assigned to minister to and pray for them by name.

high_Priest.title: The Law of Teaching
high_Priest.message: High Priests must teach the principles of the gospel as found in the scriptures, by the power of the Spirit.
high_Priest.challenge: Study a core doctrine today as if you had to teach it to a child this evening.

high_Priest.title: Administering Spiritual Things
high_Priest.message: Your office holds the keys of all the spiritual blessings of the church. This is a massive privilege.
high_Priest.challenge: List three spiritual blessings you have received through the Priesthood this year.

high_Priest.title: Humility in High Office
high_Priest.message: The more authority we are given, the more humility we require. Pride is the death of priesthood power.
high_Priest.challenge: Ask a family member or peer for feedback on how you can improve your service.

high_Priest.title: The Ministering of Angels
high_Priest.message: While often associated with the Aaronic Priesthood, the Melchizedek Priesthood also operates in the realm of unseen help.
high_Priest.challenge: Pray for the Lord to send help (seen or unseen) to a family currently in crisis.

high_Priest.title: The Pattern of Prayer
high_Priest.message: The Lord provides a pattern in all things so we are not deceived. High Priests must be masters of the Lord's patterns.
high_Priest.challenge: Evaluate a routine in your life. Does it follow the Lord’s pattern for growth and peace?

high_Priest.title: The Covenant of Sealing
high_Priest.message: High Priests are deeply tied to the work of binding on earth and in heaven.
high_Priest.challenge: Review your family's temple work progress. Identify one name to take to the temple.

high_Priest.title: Enduring Reproach
high_Priest.message: The world may not understand your devotion. A High Priest stands firm despite the 'mists of darkness.'
high_Priest.challenge: Identify a worldly trend that conflicts with your covenants and mentally recommit to your standard.

high_Priest.title: A Life of Consecration
high_Priest.message: Every man seeking to improve his talent should do so for the benefit of his neighbor.
high_Priest.challenge: Use a professional or personal talent to help a neighbor or ward member today without charge.

high_Priest.title: The Spirit of Prophecy
high_Priest.message: The testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy. High Priests lead by testifying of Christ.
high_Priest.challenge: Share your testimony of Jesus Christ in a text, letter, or conversation today.

high_Priest.title: Leading the Quorum
high_Priest.message: Even if you are not in the presidency, you contribute to the 'spiritual unity' of the Elders Quorum.
high_Priest.challenge: Reach out to your Elders Quorum president and ask, 'How can I best support our quorum right now?'

high_Priest.title: Compassion in Authority
high_Priest.message: Execute true judgment, and show mercy and compassions every man to his brother.
high_Priest.challenge: Is there someone you have been 'judging' lately? Intentionally show them extra compassion today.

high_Priest.title: The Power of Example
high_Priest.message: Be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
high_Priest.challenge: Focus on your 'conversation' today. Keep every word uplifting and free of gossip.

high_Priest.title: Deepening Study
high_Priest.message: Seek learning, even by study and also by faith. A High Priest’s mind should be a storehouse of truth.
high_Priest.challenge: Spend 20 minutes studying a topic in the 'Gospel Topics' section of the library.

high_Priest.title: The Shield of Faith
high_Priest.message: Your faith is a shield not just for you, but for your family. When the head of the house is firm, the house stands.
high_Priest.challenge: Lead a family prayer or a prayer with a loved one with extra intentionality today.

high_Priest.title: The Sanctity of Time
high_Priest.message: Thou shalt not idle away thy time, neither shalt thou bury thy talent.
high_Priest.challenge: Identify one 'time-waster' in your digital life and replace it with 15 minutes of service or study today.

high_Priest.title: The Law of Fasting
high_Priest.message: Fasting loosens the bands of wickedness. High Priests use fasting to sharpen their spiritual reception.
high_Priest.challenge: Plan your next fast with a specific 'Priesthood purpose' or person in mind.

high_Priest.title: Intercessory Prayer
high_Priest.message: The children of God were commanded to gather and join in fasting and mighty prayer in behalf of the welfare of souls.
high_Priest.challenge: Find a quiet place and offer a 'mighty prayer' specifically for the youth of your ward.

high_Priest.title: Refining the Inner Vessel
high_Priest.message: The inward vessel shall be cleansed first, and then shall the outer vessel be cleansed also.
high_Priest.challenge: What internal thought pattern needs 'cleansing'? Take it to the Lord in prayer tonight.

high_Priest.title: Month 3 Reflection: The Spiritual Sentinel
high_Priest.message: You have focused on spiritual blessings and ordinances. You are becoming a sentinel for the Kingdom.
high_Priest.challenge: Review your journey from day 61. How has your perception of Priesthood power changed from 'authority' to 'godliness'?

deacon.title: A Leader of Peers
deacon.message: Leadership isn't about age; it's about being an 'example of the believers.' Even as the youngest priesthood office, you set the tone for your friends.
deacon.challenge: Choose one friend today and tell them something you respect about them. Lead through sincere encouragement.

deacon.title: The Power of Small Things
deacon.message: Passing the sacrament or collecting fast offerings might seem small, but these small acts bring great things to pass in the lives of the Saints.
deacon.challenge: Do a small task at home today (like the dishes or taking out the trash) without being asked, just to practice 'watching over' your home.

deacon.title: Listening to the Spirit
deacon.message: To lead others, you must first learn to be led by the Holy Ghost. He speaks to your mind and your heart.
deacon.challenge: Tonight, before you pray, sit in silence for two minutes and ask: 'Is there anyone I should help tomorrow?'

deacon.title: The Deacon’s Presidency
deacon.message: If you are in a presidency, you have keys. If not, you support those who do. Quorums succeed when everyone works together.
deacon.challenge: Think of one way to make your next quorum meeting better or more fun. Share the idea with your quorum president.

deacon.title: Preparation for the Teacher's Office
deacon.message: Part of being a good Deacon is preparing for your next step. Teachers 'watch over the church always.' Start practicing that now.
deacon.challenge: Identify someone in your ward who seems lonely. Say hello to them at church this coming Sunday.

deacon.title: Honoring the Priesthood
deacon.message: The way you treat the Priesthood reflects how you feel about God. Respect the tray, the bread, and the water as sacred symbols.
deacon.challenge: Make sure your Sunday clothes are clean and ready today, showing respect for the sacred duty of the Sabbath.

deacon.title: Courage to Stand Alone
deacon.message: Sometimes leading means not following the crowd. 'Come unto Christ' even when your friends go a different way.
deacon.challenge: If you hear someone being unkind today, have the courage to change the subject or speak up for what is right.

deacon.title: Strength in Prayer
deacon.message: A Priesthood holder who doesn't pray is like a soldier without a radio. You need constant contact with headquarters (Heaven).
deacon.challenge: Pray specifically for your Bishop today. He has a heavy load and needs your Priesthood support.

deacon.title: The Law of the Fast
deacon.message: When you collect fast offerings, you are helping feed the hungry. This is a vital part of the work of salvation.
deacon.challenge: Learn about where fast offerings go by asking your parents or a leader how the Church helps the poor.

deacon.title: The 100-Day Mark
deacon.message: You have been focused on your Priesthood journey for 100 days. You are becoming a man of God.
deacon.challenge: Write down one thing you have learned about the Priesthood since you started this app.

deacon.title: Priesthood in the Home
deacon.scripture: The Family: A Proclamation to the World
deacon.message: You don't just hold the Priesthood at church. You bring its influence into your home by how you treat your siblings and parents.
deacon.challenge: Help a sibling with a task or homework today without complaining.

deacon.title: Clean Hands and Pure Hearts
deacon.message: To stand in the holy place (the sacrament table), we must be clean. This includes what we look at on our phones.
deacon.challenge: If there is an app or a habit that makes you feel less spiritual, delete it or take a break from it today.

deacon.title: The Spirit of Worship
deacon.message: The Church is commanded to meet together often to partake of the bread and wine. You are the one who makes that possible.
deacon.challenge: Read the Sacrament prayer for the bread and think about the word 'always' in 'always remember Him.'

deacon.title: Learning to Mentor
deacon.message: Soon, new Deacons will be ordained. They will look to you to see how a Priesthood holder acts.
deacon.challenge: Think of a Primary boy who will turn 12 soon. Decide to be a good example so he isn't nervous to join the quorum.

deacon.title: The Gift of Scripture
deacon.message: A leader must know the manual. The scriptures are the manual for life and Priesthood power.
deacon.challenge: Read one chapter in the Book of Mormon today and find one verse that sounds like a 'command' for a leader.

deacon.title: Reliability
deacon.message: A Deacon who can be counted on is a treasure to the Bishop. Be where you say you will be, when you say you will be there.
deacon.challenge: Set an alarm for your Sunday meetings or your chores today so you can be exactly on time.

deacon.title: The Power of Testimony
deacon.message: Leadership is built on testimony. When you know the work is true, you serve with more heart.
deacon.challenge: In your mind, list three things you know for sure about Jesus Christ.

deacon.title: Gratitude
deacon.message: A grateful leader is a happy leader. God promises that if you are thankful, you will be made glorious.
deacon.challenge: Tell your parents or a leader 'Thank you' for helping you in your Priesthood service.

deacon.title: The Duty to God
deacon.message: When you are in the service of your fellow beings, you are only in the service of your God.
deacon.challenge: Find one way to serve someone outside your family today—a neighbor, a teacher, or a friend.

deacon.title: The Bread of Life
deacon.message: As you pass the bread, remember that Jesus is the Bread of Life. Without Him, our spirits would starve.
deacon.challenge: Think about how much you need the Savior while you eat your lunch or dinner today.

deacon.title: A Standing Minister
deacon.message: The Lord calls Deacons 'standing ministers.' This means you are always 'on duty' to represent Him.
deacon.challenge: Wear your Priesthood 'spiritually' all day. Ask yourself: 'Would a minister of God say this?'

deacon.title: Self-Discipline
deacon.message: Cease to be idle; cease to be unclean... cease to sleep longer than is needful. A leader masters himself.
deacon.challenge: Go to bed at a decent time tonight so you can wake up with energy to serve tomorrow.

deacon.title: The Spirit of Compassion
deacon.message: Jesus had compassion on the people and healed them. We can 'heal' people's sadness with our kindness.
deacon.challenge: Look for someone at school or in your neighborhood who looks sad and give them a smile or a kind word.

deacon.title: The Strength of the Quorum
deacon.message: A Deacon's quorum is a brotherhood. You are stronger when you stand together in your duties.
deacon.challenge: Invite a quorum member to do something active or spiritual with you this week.

deacon.title: Fulfilling Your Calling
deacon.message: To 'magnify' a calling means to make it bigger and better than it was before you arrived.
deacon.challenge: What is one thing you can do to make the Deacons quorum better for the next person?

deacon.title: The Living Prophet
deacon.message: A leader follows the Prophet. His words are like they came from God’s own mouth.
deacon.challenge: Find a recent quote from the Prophet and share it with your family during dinner.

deacon.title: Personal Holiness
deacon.message: Practice virtue and holiness before the Lord continually. Holiness is the source of Priesthood power.
deacon.challenge: Keep your thoughts clean today. If a bad thought comes in, replace it with a hymn or a favorite scripture.

deacon.title: The Missionary Spirit
deacon.message: Even as a Deacon, you are a missionary. You share the gospel by how you live.
deacon.challenge: Be ready to answer if someone asks why you go to church or why you don't do certain things.

deacon.title: The Legacy of Service
deacon.message: When you finish this 120-day journey, you are not 'done.' You are just getting started as a servant of God.
deacon.challenge: Think about the man you want to be in 5 years. What is one thing you can do today to become him?

deacon.title: Month 4 Reflection: The Commissioned Deacon
deacon.message: You have completed 120 days of training. You are now a more powerful, more aware Priesthood holder.
deacon.challenge: Write a short 'letter of advice' to a 12-year-old just starting his journey as a Deacon. What do you know now that he needs to know?

teacher.title: The Ministering Mandate
teacher.message: The Teacher's primary leadership duty is to 'watch over the church always.' This isn't a passive observation; it is active, vigilant care.
teacher.challenge: Identify one family you minister to. Pray for them by name and ask for a specific way you can strengthen them this week.

teacher.title: Strengthening the Quorum
teacher.message: A Teacher's Quorum is a circle of brotherhood. Leadership means ensuring no one in that circle feels left out or forgotten.
teacher.challenge: Reach out to a quorum member who hasn't been to an activity lately. Let them know they are a valued part of the brotherhood.

teacher.title: Being with the Saints
teacher.message: The Lord commands Teachers to 'be with and strengthen' the members. True leadership happens when you show up and stand beside people in their trials.
teacher.challenge: Offer to help someone today with a physical task—carrying groceries, cleaning, or yard work—without being asked.

teacher.title: Ensuring No Iniquity
teacher.message: Teachers are guardians of the spiritual health of the ward. This starts with being a leader who doesn't participate in or allow gossip.
teacher.challenge: If a conversation turns to gossip or negativity today, be the leader who steer it toward a more positive topic.

teacher.title: The Teacher's Presidency
teacher.message: Teachers are often at an age where they begin to lead councils. Learning to lead a meeting with the Spirit is a vital priesthood skill.
teacher.challenge: Look at the agenda for your next quorum meeting. Prepare one spiritual thought that could help your brothers feel the Spirit.

teacher.title: Preparing for the Priest's Office
teacher.message: As you grow in the Teacher's office, you prepare to become a Priest. Priests have the authority to baptize. Prepare your heart for that sacred trust.
teacher.challenge: Read about the baptismal covenant in Mosiah 18. Think about the responsibility of performing that ordinance for another.

teacher.title: The Power of Persuasion
teacher.message: A leader in the priesthood does not force. He leads by persuasion, long-suffering, gentleness, and meekness.
teacher.challenge: Practice 'soft leadership' today. Instead of telling someone what to do, explain why it matters and invite them to join you.

teacher.title: Hardness of Heart
teacher.message: Teachers are to ensure there is no 'hardness of heart' among members. A leader helps people soften their hearts toward one another.
teacher.challenge: Is there someone you have a 'hard heart' toward? Ask God to help you see them through His eyes today.

teacher.title: The Worth of a Soul
teacher.message: Remember the worth of souls is great in the sight of God. A leader treats every person as a literal child of Heavenly Parents.
teacher.challenge: Treat every person you encounter today—even strangers—as if they were of infinite value. Notice how it changes your behavior.

teacher.title: The 100-Day Milestone
teacher.message: The Lord tries the patience and the faith of His people. You have remained consistent for 100 days. This is how priesthood power is forged.
teacher.challenge: Reflect on how your desire to serve has changed since Day 1. Write down one specific growth you've seen in yourself.

teacher.title: Leading in the Home
teacher.message: A Teacher's training is most effective when applied at home. You are a 'standing minister' to your own family.
teacher.challenge: Proactively help with a chore or a younger sibling's need before your parents have to ask you.

teacher.title: The Pattern of Preparation
teacher.message: God’s house is a house of order. Teachers help maintain this order by preparing the sacrament and the chapel for worship.
teacher.challenge: Next time you prepare the sacrament, do so with an extra measure of reverence, thinking of the Lord's order.

teacher.title: Bridging the Gap
teacher.message: As a Teacher, you are the 'middle' office of the Aaronic Priesthood. You can mentor Deacons and learn from Priests.
teacher.challenge: Ask a Priest what his favorite part of being a Priest is, and share one thing you've learned as a Teacher with a Deacon.

teacher.title: Moral Courage
teacher.message: A leader has the courage to admit weakness so that God can make him strong. Vulnerability is a priesthood strength.
teacher.challenge: In your prayers tonight, be completely honest with God about a struggle you have. Ask for His strength to overcome it.

teacher.title: Spiritual Resilience
teacher.message: Opposition is a part of leadership. When things get hard in your quorum or life, remember that growth requires resistance.
teacher.challenge: Identify a current challenge. Instead of complaining, ask: 'What is the Lord trying to teach me through this?'

teacher.title: A Teacher’s Influence
teacher.message: When a man speaketh by the power of the Holy Ghost, the Holy Ghost carrieth it unto the hearts of the children of men.
teacher.challenge: When you speak in church or in your quorum, pray beforehand that the Spirit will carry your words to someone’s heart.

teacher.title: Integrity in Leadership
teacher.message: Being honest, true, and chaste are not just rules—they are the requirements for priesthood leadership.
teacher.challenge: Check your integrity today: Did you keep every promise you made, even the small ones?

teacher.title: The Law of the Harvest
teacher.message: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
teacher.challenge: Commit to one act of service that you will repeat every day for the rest of this 120-day journey.

teacher.title: Developing Charity
teacher.message: Charity is the pure love of Christ. A Teacher cannot truly minister without it.
teacher.challenge: Pray with all the energy of your heart today to be filled with this love for those you minister to.

teacher.title: Mastering the Tongue
teacher.message: A leader’s words can build up or tear down. Use your priesthood authority to heal with your words.
teacher.challenge: Spend the entire day without saying one negative thing about anyone, including yourself.

teacher.title: Spiritual Vigilance
teacher.message: The command to 'see that there is no backbiting' requires you to be spiritually awake. A leader notices when someone is hurting.
teacher.challenge: Observe your friends today. Does anyone seem 'off'? Take a moment to check in on them.

teacher.title: The Honor of the Tray
teacher.message: Preparing the sacrament table is a holy task. It is the physical preparation for a spiritual miracle.
teacher.challenge: Think about the cleanliness of your life. Are you as prepared to touch the sacred vessels as you want to be?

teacher.title: Selfless Service
teacher.message: Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
teacher.challenge: Perform a service for someone who can never 'repay' you or do anything for you in return.

teacher.title: Pure Religion
teacher.message: To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction. This is the heart of a Teacher's ministering duty.
teacher.challenge: Is there a widow or widower in your ward? Send them a quick note or card to let them know you are thinking of them.

teacher.title: The Example of the Master
teacher.message: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
teacher.challenge: Think of one specific quality of Jesus Christ. Try to emulate that quality perfectly for one hour today.

teacher.title: Boldness, not Overbearance
teacher.message: Use boldness, but not overbearance. A leader is confident in the truth but humble in his delivery.
teacher.challenge: Share a gospel principle today with confidence, but listen more than you speak.

teacher.title: Magnifying the Office
teacher.message: We did magnify our office unto the Lord, taking upon us the responsibility, answering the sins of the people upon our own heads if we did not teach.
teacher.challenge: Take your ministering assignment seriously tonight. Pray for them as if their spiritual progress depended on your care.

teacher.title: The Fruits of the Spirit
teacher.message: Love, joy, peace, long-suffering... these are the signs of a leader who is walking with God.
teacher.challenge: Which of these 'fruits' are you missing? Ask the Lord to help you cultivate it today.

teacher.title: The Unfinished Journey
teacher.message: Let every man stand in his own office, and labor in his own calling. You have found your footing; now keep walking.
teacher.challenge: Set a spiritual goal for the next 30 days that continues the momentum you've built here.

teacher.title: Month 4 Reflection: The Watchman on the Tower
teacher.message: You have completed 120 days. You are no longer just a 'member'—you are a trained watchman for the souls of your brothers and sisters.
teacher.challenge: Look back at your journey. Who have you strengthened? How has 'watching over the church' changed your own heart?

priest.title: The Priest’s Commission
priest.message: The Priest's duty is to 'preach, teach, expound, exhort, and baptize.' You are a frontline representative of Jesus Christ.
priest.challenge: Think of one person you know who is struggling. Decide today to 'exhort' (encourage) them with a text or a kind word.

priest.title: The Authority of John the Baptist
priest.message: As a Priest, you hold the same keys John the Baptist held. You prepare the way for the Lord’s influence in people's lives.
priest.challenge: Study the words of the Aaronic Priesthood restoration. Why is the 'ministering of angels' so important to your office?

priest.title: Blessing the Bread
priest.message: When you offer the sacramental prayer, you are the voice of the congregation's covenant. Every word matters.
priest.challenge: Read the prayer for the bread slowly today. Focus on the promise to 'always remember him.' What does 'always' mean to you?

priest.title: Blessing the Wine (Water)
priest.message: The water represents the blood of Christ shed for us. As a Priest, you help offer the gift of the Spirit to the members.
priest.challenge: Consider your personal worthiness. How can you be a 'clean vessel' when you kneel at the table this Sunday?

priest.title: The Power to Baptize
priest.message: You have the authority to perform a saving ordinance. This is a literal bridge between heaven and earth.
priest.challenge: Review the baptismal prayer. Visualize yourself performing it with the dignity and power the Savior would use.

priest.title: A Standing Minister
priest.message: Like Deacons and Teachers, you are a standing minister. But as a Priest, you are expected to lead the way in spiritual maturity.
priest.challenge: Offer to lead a spiritual discussion or prayer in your home today.

priest.title: Ministering to the One
priest.message: Leadership in the Priest's office is often about finding the 'lost sheep.' You are the Bishop's eyes and ears.
priest.challenge: Ask the Bishop if there is a specific youth in the ward who could use a friend or an invitation to an activity.

priest.title: Expounding the Gospel
priest.message: To 'expound' means to explain in detail. You must know the scriptures well enough to explain them to others.
priest.challenge: Pick one core doctrine (like the Atonement) and practice explaining it in three simple sentences.

priest.title: The Law of the Fast
priest.message: Priests lead the way in fasting for the welfare of souls. Your prayers are sharpened when you sacrifice for others.
priest.challenge: Think of someone you are ministering to. Set a goal to fast for their specific needs during your next Fast Sunday.

priest.title: 100 Days of Priesthood Power
priest.message: You have reached 100 days. Let thy 'confidence wax strong in the presence of God.' You are no longer an apprentice; you are a practitioner.
priest.challenge: Look in the mirror and acknowledge: 'I am a Priest of the Most High God.' Act accordingly all day.

priest.title: Preparing for the Melchizedek Priesthood
priest.message: The Aaronic Priesthood is preparatory. You are currently training for the Oath and Covenant of the Higher Priesthood.
priest.challenge: Talk to an Elder or your father about the responsibilities they carry. What do they wish they knew when they were Priests?

priest.title: Moral Purity and Power
priest.message: Be ye clean that bear the vessels of the Lord. Your power to bless the sacrament depends on your personal purity.
priest.challenge: If there is anything in your life that would prevent you from blessing the sacrament, go talk to your Bishop today. There is power in repentance.

priest.title: The Duty to Warn
priest.message: Behold, I sent you out to testify and warn the people. As a Priest, you are an emissary of truth.
priest.challenge: When a conversation at school turns toward something harmful, be the one to steer it away or voice a different standard.

priest.title: The Spirit of the Quorum
priest.message: The Bishop presides over the Priests. You are his direct assistants in the work of salvation.
priest.challenge: Ask the Bishop: 'What is one thing you need help with this week?' and then do it.

priest.title: Personal Revelation
priest.message: A Priest must learn to 'study it out in your mind' and then ask for a burning in the bosom.
priest.challenge: Take a question you’ve been wondering about to the Lord today. Study the scriptures and wait for the feeling of peace.

priest.title: The Strength of the Savior
priest.message: You cannot fulfill your priesthood duties alone. You can do all things only through Christ who strengthens you.
priest.challenge: When you feel overwhelmed today, stop and say a short prayer: 'Lord, give me Thy strength to handle this.'

priest.title: Intercessory Prayer
priest.message: Priests pray for the people. Your heart should be big enough to hold the concerns of those around you.
priest.challenge: Pray specifically for someone who doesn't like you or who has been unkind to you lately.

priest.title: The Pattern of the Mission
priest.message: Many Priests are preparing for full-time missions. Start serving with 'all your heart, might, mind and strength' now.
priest.challenge: Practice a 'missionary habit' today—like waking up on time, studying for an hour, or serving a stranger.

priest.title: The Sacrament as a Healing Ordinance
priest.message: You facilitate healing. As you bless and pass the sacrament, you help people be 'healed' of their sins through the Atonement.
priest.challenge: Focus on the 'healing' power of the sacrament the next time you are at the table.

priest.title: Boldness in Testimony
priest.message: Use boldness, but not overbearance. A Priest should be confident in what he knows to be true.
priest.challenge: Share a spiritual thought on your social media or in a group chat today. Keep it simple and sincere.

priest.title: Self-Discipline
priest.message: A leader of the priesthood is a master of his own desires. Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
priest.challenge: Choose one thing you usually procrastinate and do it immediately today.

priest.title: The Spirit of Sacrifice
priest.message: Those who are willing to observe their covenants by sacrifice are accepted of the Lord.
priest.challenge: Sacrifice 30 minutes of entertainment today for 30 minutes of deep scripture study or service.

priest.title: Ministering to Families
priest.message: The Priest is to visit the house of each member and exhort them to pray vocally and in secret and attend to all family duties.
priest.challenge: Reach out to your ministering companion and plan a visit to a family this week.

priest.title: The Priesthood and the Temple
priest.message: Your priesthood authority is tied to the temple. It is there that we find the highest power of the priesthood.
priest.challenge: Check your temple recommend expiration date. If it’s close, or if you don’t have one, schedule an interview.

priest.title: Humility in Authority
priest.message: Be thou humble; and the Lord thy God shall lead thee by the hand, and give thee answer to thy prayers.
priest.challenge: Do a service today for which you receive absolutely no credit or thanks.

priest.title: The Light of the World
priest.message: You are a light. Don't hide it. Your priesthood should be visible in your kindness and integrity.
priest.challenge: Identify one area of your life where you could 'shine' more brightly. Work on it today.

priest.title: The Fruits of Priesthood Service
priest.message: The reward for magnifying your calling is being 'sanctified by the Spirit unto the renewing of your bodies.'
priest.challenge: Notice the physical and mental peace you feel after a day of dedicated service.

priest.title: Enduring to the End
priest.message: You are near the end of this 120-day journey. Press forward with a steadfastness in Christ.
priest.challenge: Write down your 'Priesthood Goal' for the next year. What kind of Melchizedek Priesthood holder do you want to be?

priest.title: The Unbroken Chain
priest.message: The priesthood has been passed down from Adam to today. You are now a link in that eternal chain.
priest.challenge: Think about the man who ordained you. Send him a quick note of thanks for passing that authority to you.

priest.title: Month 4 Reflection: The Priest of the Lord
priest.message: You have completed your 120-day training. You are a Priest authorized to act in the name of God. Rise up and lead.
priest.challenge: Look back at Day 1. How has your understanding of the Sacrament and Baptism changed? Commitment to stay on this path forever.

elder.title: A Higher Commission
elder.message: As an Elder, you are a 'standing minister' to the world. Your leadership begins with the realization that you represent the Lord in every room you enter.
elder.challenge: Before your first meeting or task today, ask: 'How would the Savior handle this interaction?' Then do it.

elder.title: The First Circle of Leadership
elder.message: An Elder's primary leadership role is in the home. To lead in the Church but fail at home is to miss the mark of the Priesthood.
elder.challenge: Perform a task today that lightens the load of your spouse or a family member without being asked.

elder.title: Counseling Together
elder.message: Leadership is not giving orders; it is counseling. True leaders listen more than they speak and seek a 'oneness' of mind.
elder.challenge: In a conversation today, practice 'active listening.' Restate what the other person said to ensure they feel understood.

elder.title: The Spirit of Presiding
elder.message: Presiding means to provide. You provide spiritual safety, love, and a righteous example. It is never about control.
elder.challenge: Identify a moment today where you could be 'forceful.' Intentionally choose 'gentleness' and 'meekness' instead.

elder.title: Keys and Authority
elder.message: While you may not hold keys, you act under the direction of those who do. Respect for keys is respect for God's order.
elder.challenge: Pray specifically for your Elders Quorum President and Bishop today. Acknowledge the weight of the keys they carry.

elder.title: The Power of Blessing
elder.message: An Elder is called to heal. This includes physical healing by the laying on of hands and emotional healing through kind words.
elder.challenge: Is there someone in your home or ward who is 'hurting' emotionally? Offer a word of comfort or a listening ear today.

elder.title: Mentoring the Aaronic Priesthood
elder.message: The strong should take with them the weak (or the young) that they may be made strong also. You are a mentor to the youth.
elder.challenge: Take a moment to encourage a young man in your ward. Acknowledge a strength you see in him.

elder.title: The Work of Salvation
elder.message: Elders lead in four ways: Living the Gospel, Caring for those in need, Inviting all to receive the Gospel, and Uniting families.
elder.challenge: Pick one of these four areas. Do one deliberate act today to move that work forward.

elder.title: Consecration of Time
elder.message: A leader in the Melchizedek Priesthood seeks the interest of his neighbor. Every talent you have belongs to the Lord.
elder.challenge: Use a professional skill or personal hobby to help someone else today for free.

elder.title: 100 Days of Ministry
elder.message: 100 days in. Let thy bowels be full of charity toward all men. Charity is the identifying mark of a true Elder.
elder.challenge: Write down the names of your ministering families. Ask God to give you 'His love' for them today.

elder.title: The Power of the Word
elder.message: The word has a 'more powerful effect' than the sword. An Elder leads through the word of God, not through personal opinion.
elder.challenge: In a discussion today, share a scripture or a prophetic quote rather than just your own thoughts.

elder.title: Pure Religion
elder.message: To visit the fatherless and widows. Elders ensure that the vulnerable in the ward are never forgotten.
elder.challenge: Check in on a widow or a single parent in your neighborhood. Ask: 'What is one thing I can do for you this weekend?'

elder.title: Integrity in the Marketplace
elder.message: An Elder is honest in his business dealings. Your priesthood is tied to your integrity at work.
elder.challenge: Be 'scrupulously honest' today in your time-keeping, your words, and your financial dealings.

elder.title: The Law of the Fast
elder.message: Fasting is a tool for leadership. It provides the clarity and humility needed to solve complex problems.
elder.challenge: If you are facing a difficult decision, plan a fast specifically for clarity on that choice.

elder.title: United in Purpose
elder.message: If ye are not one ye are not mine. An Elder works to build unity in his quorum and his home.
elder.challenge: Is there a misunderstanding between you and someone else? Be the one to reach out and reconcile today.

elder.title: The Sentinel of the Home
elder.message: The Lord rebuked Frederick G. Williams for not teaching his children. We must be spiritual sentinels for our families.
elder.challenge: Lead a short spiritual discussion or read a scripture with your family or a loved one tonight.

elder.title: Repentance as Leadership
elder.message: A leader who repents is a leader who grows. Do not fear your weaknesses; bring them to the Lord.
elder.challenge: Identify a small habit that is beneath your priesthood. Commit to the Lord to leave it behind today.

elder.title: The Gift of Discernment
elder.message: Discernment allows an Elder to see the needs of others that are not visible to the natural eye.
elder.challenge: During your day, silently ask: 'Heavenly Father, what is this person really feeling?' Listen for the answer.

elder.title: Enduring Reproach
elder.message: An Elder is not moved by the winds of social opinion. He is anchored in the Rock of his Redeemer.
elder.challenge: When you encounter an opinion that mocks your faith today, respond with kindness but stay firm in your conviction.

elder.title: Ministering to the Spirit
elder.message: An Elder's duty is to 'visit the house of each member.' This is about soul-to-soul connection.
elder.challenge: Send a 'spiritual check-in' text to a friend or ministering brother. No business, just 'how is your soul?'

elder.title: Self-Mastery
elder.message: Cease from all your light speeches... from all your lustful desires. A Melchizedek Priesthood holder is a master of himself.
elder.challenge: Identify one 'app' or 'habit' that drains your spiritual energy. Delete it or set a strict limit today.

elder.title: Building the Kingdom
elder.message: The Priesthood is the engine that drives the Kingdom of God on earth. You are part of that engine.
elder.challenge: Find one way to support a local ward mission or temple effort this week.

elder.title: The Power of Testimony
elder.message: Your testimony is recorded in heaven. When you speak of Christ, the angels rejoice.
elder.challenge: Share your testimony of a gospel principle with a family member or in a private journal entry today.

elder.title: The Unseen Help
elder.message: I will be on your right hand and on your left... and mine angels round about you, to bear you up.
elder.challenge: When you feel alone in your service today, pause and remember the unseen help promised to you.

elder.title: Magnifying the Office
elder.message: Magnifying isn't about doing more work; it's about seeing the work as more sacred.
elder.challenge: Take a routine priesthood task (like a meeting or visit) and treat it today as if it were the most important thing you'll ever do.

elder.title: A Life of Prayer
elder.message: Pray always, that you may come off conqueror. An Elder's power is maintained on his knees.
elder.challenge: Add a midday prayer today. Just 2 minutes to reconnect with the Source of your power.

elder.title: The Temple Legacy
elder.message: We ask thee... that thy servants may go forth from this house armed with thy power.
elder.challenge: Check your temple recommend. If you can, schedule a time to go. If not, study the dedicatory prayer of the Kirtland Temple.

elder.title: Becoming a Patriarch
elder.message: Every Elder is a potential patriarch to his posterity. What legacy are you leaving for those who come after you?
elder.challenge: Write down one spiritual experience you’ve had during these 118 days for your children or future family to read.

elder.title: The Commissioning
elder.message: Let every man stand in his own office and labor in his own calling. You are a permanent agent of the Lord.
elder.challenge: Identify the 'one thing' you will keep doing after Day 120 to stay spiritually strong.

elder.title: Month 4 Reflection: The Elder's Commission
elder.message: You have completed 120 days. You have moved from identity to power to legacy. You are an Elder in the Church of Jesus Christ.
elder.challenge: Review your journal. How has your 'personal connection' to the priesthood changed? Commit to being a lifelong servant.

high_Priest.title: The Mantle of the High Priest
high_Priest.message: A High Priest is called to preside over spiritual things. Your leadership is characterized by a breadth of vision and a depth of spirit that stabilizes the ward and stake.
high_Priest.challenge: Seek a moment today to provide 'spiritual stability' in a chaotic situation at work or home through your calm demeanor.

high_Priest.title: A Life of Intercession
high_Priest.message: Following the pattern of the Great High Priest, Jesus Christ, your role involves intercession—praying and acting on behalf of those who cannot help themselves.
high_Priest.challenge: Identify a family or individual in your quorum currently in crisis. Offer a specific, private prayer for their deliverance.

high_Priest.title: The Spirit of the Council
high_Priest.message: High Priests often lead or participate in high-level councils. Success in a council is found when every member feels the liberty to speak and the Spirit to unify.
high_Priest.challenge: In your next meeting, intentionally invite the opinion of someone who hasn't spoken yet.

high_Priest.title: The Law of Consecration
high_Priest.message: Leadership as a High Priest is a step toward total consecration. You are not just giving your time; you are giving your heart to the Lord's work.
high_Priest.challenge: Evaluate your current 'offering' to the Lord. Is there one 'talent' or 'resource' you are holding back? Commit to use it for His work today.

high_Priest.title: Fathering the Next Generation
high_Priest.message: High Priests serve as spiritual fathers. Your legacy is found in the strength of the young men and Elders you mentor.
high_Priest.challenge: Share a 5-minute 'war story' of faith with a younger man today—a time the Priesthood worked in your life.

high_Priest.title: The Keys of Spiritual Blessings
high_Priest.message: You hold the right to officiate in all spiritual blessings. This is a call to be a channel of grace for the sick, the afflicted, and the weary.
high_Priest.challenge: Check in with the Bishop to see if there are any 'forgotten' shut-ins or elderly members who need a Priesthood visit.

high_Priest.title: Unrighteous Dominion
high_Priest.message: The higher the office, the greater the temptation for pride. A High Priest must be the most humble man in the room.
high_Priest.challenge: Perform a menial task today that is 'beneath' your status to remind yourself that you are a servant first.

high_Priest.title: The Power of the Sealing
high_Priest.message: High Priests are deeply connected to the work of the temple and the binding of generations.
high_Priest.challenge: Spend 15 minutes on FamilySearch today. Find a name or a story that connects you to your ancestors.

high_Priest.title: Meekness in Authority
high_Priest.message: The High Priesthood is 'after the order of his Son.' This order is defined by being 'lowly in heart.'
high_Priest.challenge: Respond to a criticism or a correction today with total patience and no defensiveness.

high_Priest.title: 100 Days: The Sentinel's View
high_Priest.message: 100 days of training have sharpened your spiritual eyes. You are a watchman on the tower for your family and ward.
high_Priest.challenge: Write down three 'spiritual trends' you see in your family or quorum. What does the Lord want you to do about them?

high_Priest.title: The Order of Melchizedek
high_Priest.message: Melchizedek 'wrought righteousness' and 'stopped the mouths of lions.' As a High Priest, you have the power to bring peace to your home.
high_Priest.challenge: Deliberately resolve a conflict in your home today using soft words and Priesthood perspective.

high_Priest.title: Purity of Thought
high_Priest.message: Let virtue garnish thy thoughts unceasingly. A High Priest’s confidence in God's presence is directly tied to his mental purity.
high_Priest.challenge: Guard your 'eye gate' today. If an image or thought is not virtuous, turn away immediately and replace it with a hymn.

high_Priest.title: The Stewardship of Wisdom
high_Priest.message: A High Priest should be a repository of 'best books' and spiritual experience. Your wisdom is a gift to be shared.
high_Priest.challenge: Read a recent conference talk and identify one 'advanced' principle you can apply to your leadership.

high_Priest.title: Ministering to the Leaders
high_Priest.message: Just as Aaron and Hur held up Moses' hands, High Priests hold up the hands of the Bishop and Stake President.
high_Priest.challenge: Send a note of sincere appreciation to your Bishop. Let him know you are standing with him.

high_Priest.title: The Gift of Prophecy
high_Priest.message: The testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy. High Priests should be the foremost witnesses of Christ's living reality.
high_Priest.challenge: Bear your testimony to a family member or in a private setting today. Focus entirely on the Savior.

high_Priest.title: The Patriarchal Order
high_Priest.message: The High Priesthood is inherently patriarchal. You are building a spiritual dynasty that will outlast your life.
high_Priest.challenge: Write a 'Father's Charge'—a list of values you want your descendants to live by.

high_Priest.title: The Law of the Fast: Deep Connection
high_Priest.message: When a High Priest fasts, 'his light shall break forth as the morning.' Use the fast to gain revelation for those you lead.
high_Priest.challenge: Identify a specific person you lead who is struggling. Fast for them during your next opportunity.

high_Priest.title: Presiding with Charity
high_Priest.message: Without charity, all your presiding and officiating is 'nothing.' Charity is the ultimate Priesthood power.
high_Priest.challenge: In your prayers, ask for the 'pure love of Christ' to be bestowed upon you for your quorum or family.

high_Priest.title: Spiritual Resilience
high_Priest.message: All these things shall give thee experience, and shall be for thy good. A High Priest is a man who has been refined by fire.
high_Priest.challenge: Look at a current hardship through the lens of eternity. How is the Lord using this to 'refine' your priesthood?

high_Priest.title: Teaching the Higher Law
high_Priest.message: A High Priest doesn't just teach rules; he teaches the law of perfection. He invites others to become like God.
high_Priest.challenge: Correct someone today (if necessary) with so much love and 'gentleness' that they feel closer to God after the interaction.

high_Priest.title: Self-Correction
high_Priest.message: If you have felt to sing the song of redeeming love, can you feel so now? High Priests must be masters of self-evaluation.
high_Priest.challenge: Do an 'inventory' of your soul tonight. Is there any pride or resentment creeping back in?

high_Priest.title: The Power of the Holy Ghost
high_Priest.message: When you speak by the power of the Holy Ghost, the Spirit carries the message to the hearts of others. You are just the conduit.
high_Priest.challenge: Before you speak to anyone about spiritual matters today, silently pray: 'Thy words, Lord, not mine.'

high_Priest.title: Ministering to the Sick
high_Priest.message: Call for the elders of the church... and the prayer of faith shall save the sick. High Priests are ministers of healing.
high_Priest.challenge: Is there someone in your ward who is ill? Offer to go with another brother to provide a blessing if appropriate.

high_Priest.title: The Eternal Perspective
high_Priest.message: Thy dominion shall be an everlasting dominion. A High Priest lives today with 1,000 years from now in mind.
high_Priest.challenge: Ask yourself: 'Will this thing I am worried about matter in 100 years?' If not, let the stress go.

high_Priest.title: Magnifying through Service
high_Priest.message: Magnifying your office is about taking upon you the responsibility for the souls of your people.
high_Priest.challenge: Think of one person you have 'stewardship' over. What is one thing you can do to ensure their spiritual safety today?

high_Priest.title: The Living Oracle
high_Priest.message: High Priests are called to be 'living oracles'—men who receive and distribute the word of God.
high_Priest.challenge: Write down a prompting you received today. Acting on small promptings qualifies you for larger ones.

high_Priest.title: The Temple Sanctuary
high_Priest.message: Establish a house of prayer, a house of fasting, a house of faith. Your home should be a satellite of the temple.
high_Priest.challenge: Remove one 'distraction' (noise, clutter, or media) from your home today to make it more like the temple.

high_Priest.title: The Legacy of Peace
high_Priest.message: Melchizedek did establish peace in the land in his days. Your final legacy is the peace you leave behind in people's hearts.
high_Priest.challenge: Write a letter of encouragement to a grandchild or a young person you know, testifying of the peace found in Christ.

high_Priest.title: Standing in Your Office
high_Priest.message: The training ends, but the office remains. You are a High Priest forever after the order of the Son of God.
high_Priest.challenge: Decide on one 'High Priest ritual' (a specific prayer, study, or service habit) you will never stop doing.

high_Priest.title: Month 4 Reflection: The Spiritual Father
high_Priest.message: You have completed 120 days. You have moved from identity to power to legacy. You are a sentinel for the Kingdom of God.
high_Priest.challenge: Look at the man you were 120 days ago. Give thanks to God for the 'renewing of your body' and spirit. Rise up and lead.
